# Accepted claims

### claim-claim-create-orchestration
- basis: observed

ReservationService.create looks up the member and tool, parses date strings, constructs a Reservation, applies policy, saves it and returns its view.

Evidence:
- file: src/application/reservation-service.ts:1-75

### claim-claim-lifecycle-transitions
- basis: observed

ReservationService.get returns a view or throws NotFoundError; confirm changes held to confirmed, while cancel is idempotent for cancelled reservations.

Evidence:
- file: src/application/reservation-service.ts:1-75
- file: src/domain/reservation.ts:1-76

### claim-claim-repository-substitution
- basis: supported-inference

ReservationService can receive alternate member, tool and reservation storage implementations because its dependency type names repository interfaces and the server separately chooses in-memory implementations.

Evidence:
- file: src/application/reservation-service.ts:1-75
- file: src/server.ts:1-35
